thread:
olivia_cs: FYI - Fjord Health hit a blocker during SI cutover. AzureGov marketplace attestation failing + missing nvidia_uvm on their nodes.

sam_infra: Can you paste the attestation error and image ref? we'll check manifest digests and prepare rollback.

olivia_cs: error: "x509: certificate signed by unknown authority" image: registry://redwood-marketplace/edge-gateway:2026-03.

maya_fieldeng: On-site checked node: RHEL 8.6, dkms shows nvidia 470.182.03 installed, but `lsmod` has no nvidia_uvm. They missed UVM build step.

nate_security: Attestation shows a customer intermediate CA not in our attestor whitelist. Options: request CA upload to marketplace, temporary allowlist for canary (security sign-off), or rollback to last-good image.

zoe_partner_ops: AzureGov policies are strict; I can open a partner escalation but need CA PEM + marketplace manifest digest.

sam_infra: I'll stage a manifest pin in staging and provide the kubectl one-liner to patch to an older digest if we need to rollback.

maya_fieldeng: Quick remediation for customer: run `dkms autoinstall` then `nvidia-modprobe --create-uvm` and reboot one node to verify. Lina (customer) says they'll try.

olivia_cs: Proposed immediate plan: 1) 30m triage w/ field-eng + infra + security, 2) attempt node UVM build, 3) prepare rollback manifest + test, 4) partner escalation to AzureGov. I'll coordinate comms.

deploy-bot: Ticket #INC-48900 created: "FjordHealth SI: AzureGov attestation + UVM missing" assigned to partnerships@redwood.

sam_infra: staging patch applied and smoke tests green. Holding prod rollback ready if needed.

nate_security: Drafted temporary allowlist approval: expires 48h, archived CA chain in ticket, postmortem required. Dropping into ticket for sign-off.

olivia_cs: Thanks team - will run the 30m sync at 16:00 PT and update Fjord after. Please paste any logs into #INC-48900. :thumbsup:
